Screenshots show a stone passage into Stormwind, the Trade District, Morgan Pestle, and the canal docks.

Nighttime rain over the cobbled road and trees outside Goldshire, seen in photographs around 21:29.
Rain falls on the main road as Xuthar walks back toward Lion's Pride Inn after Stormwind.
